description: Preserve absurd actor commands while delegating non-actor EAT/DROP/THROW/PUT commands back to canonical Zork verb authorities

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE V-MARA-EAT-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-EAT-REFUSAL>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME> <TELL "Eating yourself is not a useful interpretation of that command." CR>)
          (T <TELL "That is a person, not food." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-MARA-EAT-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-EAT-REFUSAL>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME> <TELL "Eating yourself is not a useful interpretation of that command." CR>)
          (<FSET? ,PRSO ,ACTORBIT> <TELL "That is a person, not food." CR>)
          (T <V-EAT>)>
    <RTRUE>>
